- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — The fleet console · taken up at `be4a06e2` (ci#46130927638 green 7 of 7)

- **Decided by:** the operator's own answers F1–F8 and the scaffold wrap's fork (a) and (b), relayed verbatim

`viola console` stops drawing one fixed frame and shows the fleet: the instances of its home as the board's lineage
forest, each row in the board's own words (LIVE, STATUS, WHEEL, DIALOG, CLI), a console-only seventh cell `LAST`
holding the age of the row's newest event-log line, every cell through the board's row escaping, the row cut at
the terminal's width ending `...` and a fleet past the frame ending in one `... <n> more` line. The frame is kept
current: the board is re-read once a second and redrawn only when the drawn lines (or the size) change, and the
`claude agents --json` read that gives STATUS idle or busy runs at most once every 5 s on a thread of its own, off
the drawing loop, its failure degrading to `unknown` as the board's does (his F2–F7, inputs#I3; research M1–M8).

It reuses the board read model and the row builder as they are (`board::scan` / `board::read` at
`crates/viola-state/src/board.rs:65` / `:398`, `forest` and `board_rows` at `src/human/board/rows.rs:25` / `:81`),
so `viola list`, `list --json` and the MCP list tool stay byte-identical; the six captions keep their words and
slots (layout-templates · decision/shared-captions-fixed; CARRY `cry-geee3cfh`), `LAST` after them. The console
stays its own surface: alternate screen, plain ASCII, no colour, no key beyond `q`, Ctrl-C and «unbound»
(layout-templates · decision/console-own-surface; design-system · contract/fleet-console-keys/q). «stalled» is the
board's `stale` (his F3). The tiled quarter-screen half of matrix#v2-14 is his live reading, never fired here: the
claim is GATED on it.

1. **The row's last-activity time (viola-state).** In `crates/viola-state/src/board.rs`, the log pass
   (`log_pass`, `board.rs:382`) also returns the `ts` of the newest line it read whole (the `EventLine.ts`,
   `crates/viola-state/src/events.rs:33`), parsed as RFC 3339 into a UTC instant, `None` when no line parses. `Item`
   gains `last_activity: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>` marked `#[serde(skip)]`, so no `list --json` item and
   no MCP list item carries it (his F2). A snapshot row takes it from its pass (`board.rs:416`); a replayed row takes
   it from one more `log_pass` of its directory; an unwrapped row (`Item::unwrapped`) holds `None`. Keeps tests S1,
   S2, S3 (rstest cases inline, literal oracles).

2. **The skip lines split out of the read (viola-state).** `board::read` keeps its behaviour for every caller: its
   two `parse-rejected{parser:"state-entry"}` lines (`board.rs:458-470`) move into a `pub fn log_skips(scan: &Scan)`
   that `read` calls last, and a `pub fn read_rows(scan, now) -> Board` holds the read without those lines. The
   console calls `read_rows` and `log_skips` (step 5). The existing cases at `board.rs:653` and `board.rs:684`
   still read one line per nonzero count from `read`.

3. **The fleet text (human module).** New `src/human/fleet.rs`, exported through `src/human.rs`: from a `Board` and
   an instant it builds the view's lines, one string each, no SGR:
   - the caption row: the board's six captions in their slots (the `[NAME_CAPTION, "LIVE", "STATUS", "WHEEL",
     DIALOG_WORD, "CLI"]` array, `src/human/board/rows.rs:108`) then `LAST`, every cell padded as the board pads it
     (`contract/viola-list-board/column-widths`) and CLI padded to its widest cell in the frame so `LAST` starts in
     one column, two-space gutters;
   - the wrapped rows in the board's forest order with the NAME indent (`forest`, `rows.rs:25`), their cells the
     board's own (`wheel_cell`, `dialog_cell`, `cli_cell`, `cells.rs:15-44`), then, when the board holds any, the
     `-- UNWRAPPED - READ-ONLY --` line and the unwrapped rows (`n/a` in WHEEL, DIALOG, CLI and `LAST`); with no
     wrapped row, the board's empty-board line (`rows.rs:145`). No LINKS block and no BAY line;
   - the `LAST` cell: the age now minus `last_activity` in one unit, whole and floored: under 60 s `12s`, under 60 min
     `4m`, under 24 h `2h`, else `3d`; a time ahead of now reads `0s`; `None` on a wrapped row reads `unknown`;
   - every cell through `escape_row` (`src/human/escape.rs:20`), the board's row mode.
   `src/human/board/rows.rs` gains a `pub(crate)` function giving the forest's rows as their six cells and indent,
   which `board_rows` itself then uses, so the board's lines are unchanged (its literal cases at
   `rows.rs:201`–`rows.rs:950` are the guard); `src/human/board.rs` exports it, and `cells.rs` exposes the cell
   functions to it. A cut helper in `fleet.rs` cuts a line to N columns ending `...` (N − 3 characters kept), never
   inside a `\xHH` escape (the `escape_at` rule, `cells.rs:113-120`), a line of N or fewer left whole. Keeps design
   S1 and S2, a11y S2 (`LAST`, `... <n> more` pinned by literal), tests S2 and S3.

4. **The frame model (console).** New `src/console/view.rs`: `View::of(lines, size)` lays the fleet lines into the
   body rows between the title row and the key line (rows − 2 at a size that fits the floor, `frame.rs:6`): when the
   lines fit, every line; when they do not, the first rows − 3 lines then `... <n> more`, `n` the lines left out
   (his F5). Every drawn line is cut to the terminal's columns (step 3's cut). It records `shown` (lines drawn, the
   more line not counted) and `hidden` (`n`, else 0), and two views compare equal when their drawn lines are equal.
   `src/console/frame.rs` gains the body row count.

5. **The board source (console).** New `src/console/fleet.rs`: one board read through `board::scan` then
   `board::read_rows` at `now`, joined (`board::join`, `board.rs:478`) with the newest observations the agents
   thread handed over; a refused scan is an `Err` (step 7). The agents thread runs
   `run::agents::read_here(home, cwd)` (`src/run/agents.rs:113`) at most once every 5 s, its cwd the console's
   current dir, each result handed to the loop by a channel; a failed read hands no observations, so STATUS reads
   `unknown` (architecture · contract/board/agents-read-failure). The thread is never joined on quit: no key waits on
   it (a11y · decision/time-bounds-never-on-human). `log_skips` runs only when the scan's pair of skip counts differs
   from the pair last logged, the first read logging a nonzero pair (his F7).

6. **The loop (console).** `src/console/mod.rs`'s `run` takes the board source beside the size source. It reads the
   board once at start and then once a second, counted on the 100 ms poll it already runs (`mod.rs:22`); after each
   key or timeout it builds the view and draws only when the view or the size differs from the one drawn
   (`mod.rs:126-129` widened from size to size or view). `Screen::draw` writes the view's lines through
   `src/human/console.rs`'s frame writer, now taking the lines: the cleared top-left, `viola console` on row 1, the
   body lines from row 2, `q quit` on the last row; below the floor the one size line, as today. Its `console-frame`
   line gains `shown` and `hidden` (T2). `src/cmd/console.rs` builds the board source from the home and hands it in.

7. **A mid-run refused scan.** A board read whose scan is refused (a home, `instances/` or an instance another user
   may read, widened while the console runs) ends the loop: the terminal restored, `process-exit{subject:"self",
   exit_code:1, detail:"strict-modes-failed"}` logged, the scaffold's home pair
   (`HOME_REFUSED`, `src/cmd/console.rs:23-26`) on stderr, exit 1 — the verb's «1 on a refusal»
   (layout-templates · contract/cli-verbs/console) with its existing pair, no third form. Leaned per that row and
   `contract/strict-modes-refusal/console`; named on the card.

8. **The line's schema.** `schemas/diag-line.v1.json`'s `console-frame` arm (`:94-96`) gains `shown` and `hidden`,
   each a `count`, both required; `crates/viola-core/src/obs.rs:11`'s doc names them. No new event:
   `LOG_FORMAT_EVENTS` (`obs.rs:174`) and both schemas' event enums are unchanged. Keeps obs S1.

9. **The keystroke driver.** `tests/tui_console.rs` gains cases that read state, never the screen, each under a
   test-owned home and its own outer PTY, with `PATH` set to a test-scoped bin dir (tests ·
   decision/tests-never-read-host-sessions), every wait under `WITHIN`:

     (caption and row); its stop reads one with `shown` 2 again over the empty-board line, and a third boot raises

     `process-start` and `process-exit` pair lands, and `q` still quits with exit 0;
   - `console_ends_one_on_a_home_widened_mid_run` — the home widened after the first frame ends the console with
     exit 1, the home pair on stderr and one `process-exit` with detail `strict-modes-failed`;
   - every case's lines pass `schemas/diag-line.v1.json` (`load_schema`, as the file's cases do).
   Keeps tests S1, S2, S6, arch S1, S2, S4, obs S2, S3, security S1.

    - `src/human/fleet.rs`: `fleet_caption_row_is_the_six_captions_then_last`,
      `fleet_rows_keep_the_forest_order_and_indent`, `fleet_last_cell_reads_the_age_in_one_unit` (cases 12s, 4m, 2h,
      3d, ahead reads 0s, none reads unknown, unwrapped reads n/a), `fleet_cells_escape_every_control_character`,
      `fleet_state_words_are_the_boards` (stale, `DIALOG question`, busy, `human`, `unverified-cli`),

    - `src/console/view.rs`: `view_lines_that_fit_are_drawn_whole`, `view_past_the_rows_ends_in_the_more_line`

    - `src/console/mod.rs`: `console_run_redraws_when_the_view_changes`,
      `console_run_draws_once_while_size_and_view_stand`, `console_run_on_a_refused_board_restores_then_ends`;
    - `src/console/fleet.rs`: `fleet_source_logs_the_skip_line_only_when_the_count_changes`,

    The scaffold's own cases keep passing as they stand, their frame literals moved to the body-row form where step 6
